text:
maria gomez: Heads-up: launching 'Morning Canvas' social push tomorrow AM. Need final assets, UTMs, and who handles inbound routing. Quick sync here. :rocket:
sam irwin: i've got two copy tracks ready: X-short (technical hook) and LN-long (customer narrative). i'll paste both shortly.
alex lee: exporting hero video (25s) + 2 stills. will drop paths in thread when done.
olivia chan: suggest X lead with latency hook, LinkedIn lead with case study angle.
jordan reyes: routing: DMs -> sam, comment escalations -> community triage (i'll monitor 09:00-12:00 PST).

maria gomez: UTM to use: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=mc_q2_launch&utm_content={variant} — replace {variant} with x-tech or ln-story.

social-scheduler: queued: X 08:40 PST (X-short + hero25 + thumb1), LinkedIn 09:05 PST (LN-long + static thumb2).

sam irwin: Posting drafts:
X-short: "LLM features shouldn't force you to pick speed or cost. Morning Canvas gives predictable latency and lower unit costs. Demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-tech"
LN-long: "Building with LLMs at scale means balancing latency, cost, and reliability. Morning Canvas unifies serving with observability so teams ship faster. Join our demo to see the dashboard and setup guide: <link>?utm_content=ln-story"

alex lee: assets uploaded to /marketing/assets/morning-canvas/ (hero25.mp4, thumb1.jpg, thumb2.jpg). alt text added.
olivia chan: i'll draft top-8 reply templates for common Qs (pricing, model support, private deploys) and post by 08:30.
maria gomez: preflight checklist at 08:05 PST — i'll do brand/compliance. jordon will confirm registrant routing to Airtable.
jordan reyes: i'll wire a Zap to the signups form that creates Airtable rows and notifies SDRs. will confirm link when live.
social-scheduler: preflight passed at 08:06 PST. posts still queued.
maria gomez: final: split test headlines speed vs savings (50/50). sam, label scheduler variants x-tech-A / x-tech-B. Report back engagement after 2 hours. Good run everyone. :thumbsup:
